# OpenSRM Service Reliability Manifest
# Migrated from legacy NthLayer format
# Original file: analytics-stream.yaml
#
# For more information, see:
# https://github.com/rsionnach/opensrm
#

apiVersion: srm/v1
kind: ServiceReliabilityManifest
metadata:
  name: analytics-stream
  team: data
  tier: high
  description: Real-time analytics event processing pipeline
spec:
  type: stream
  slos:
    processing-availability:
      type: availability
      target: 99.5
      window: 30d
    stream-lag:
      type: availability
      target: 99.0
      window: 30d
    event-latency-p99:
      type: latency
      target: 95.0
      window: 30d
  dependencies:
  - name: analytics_db
    type: database
    critical: false
  - name: stream_cache
    type: database
    critical: false
  ownership:
    team: data
